tagline: The AI coding playbook, delivered weekly.
value_proposition: VibeCoding Newsletter is the practitioner-written weekly digest for developers actively adopting AI-native development workflows. While general AI newsletters cover AI news and research briefings, VibeCoding Newsletter delivers tested prompt patterns, tool comparisons, workflow breakdowns, and career intelligence written by builders who use Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, and Windsurf daily in production. It is the editorial hub for the Veridux Labs vibe-coding education ecosystem.
target_audience: Software developers (junior to senior) actively adopting AI coding tools like Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, and Windsurf
Engineering managers and tech leads evaluating AI development tooling for their teams and assessing productivity impact
Indie hackers and solo founders using AI coding tools to build and ship products without a full engineering team
Computer science students and career changers entering the AI-augmented development job market
CTOs and VP Engineering researching how AI is reshaping developer productivity, team structure, and hiring
key_features: Weekly practitioner-written deep dives on AI coding tools, prompt patterns, and vibe coding workflows
Tool comparison content: head-to-head breakdowns of Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, Windsurf, and Codeium
Workflow breakdowns: real coding sessions with AI tools dissected step-by-step
Career intelligence: how AI is changing developer hiring, salaries, and required skillsets
Buttondown-powered email delivery with clean, distraction-free reading experience
Standalone Next.js landing page optimized for newsletter subscriber conversion
Cross-promotion to Vibe Coding Academy, VibeCoding Ebook, and EndOfCoding for depth-seeking readers
Community access: readers connect with other AI-native developers in the Veridux Labs community

features: Early access to Veridux Labs product launches

Practitioner-written with real code, real prompts, and real production workflows — not journalist summaries
